correctness.rationale: For every finite field of characteristic above five, fix the first-coordinate sum; the zero fiber contributes 1+(q-1)g and every nonzero fiber is a union of the diagonal-square locus and a quartic curve. Conic sign-lifting yields exactly two cubic character sums; the intersection is counted explicitly. The root-discriminant conditions identify characteristic eleven as the only singular exception, evaluated directly. Additive character orthogonality gives the fourth moment. Direct integer enumerations over twenty prime and extension fields independently check all formulas, but the infinite-family proof is analytic.

value.rationale: The exact additive energy is a natural nonconstant arithmetic Fourier fourth-moment invariant for the sparse sextic curve, not an arbitrary numerical slice. Its reduction to two independently varying genus-one Frobenius traces and its structural characteristic-eleven degeneration give an infinite-field family classification and a jump in the normalized constant-input moment from 3 to 4. The result does not claim a general sharp operator norm.
